Read `lib/args.js` and explain in three sentences what it does. Do not modify any file, do not use subagents and do not run any commands.

Use the Agent tool to spawn two subagents in parallel: the first one lists the exported functions of `packages/core/src/index.ts`, the second one lists the functions used in `packages/web/src/app.ts`. When both have answered, summarize which core functions the web package does not use. Do not modify any file and do not run any commands.
